BrochureContent.Content:
We are delighted to bring to the market this impressive two-storey A2 rated, modern home, ideally positioned within the highly sought-after Pearson's Brook Development.
Extending to approximately 135.2 sq. m. (1,455 sq. ft.), this beautifully presented property is finished to an excellent standard throughout and combines contemporary style with generous, well-proportioned accommodation. The home benefits from quality fixtures and fittings, stylish interiors and excellent decorative order, making it ready for immediate occupation.
Upon entering, the welcoming hallway features bespoke fitted understairs storage and leads through to the principal living accommodation. The elegantly appointed kitchen/dining area is a particular highlight, offering a modern and practical space with direct access to the south-east-facing landscaped rear garden and paved patios, perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining.
The contemporary sitting room is both stylish and comfortable, featuring an insert electric fire and a dedicated recessed TV area. A guest WC off the entrance hallway and separate utility room, conveniently located off the kitchen, complete the ground-floor accommodation.
Upstairs, the impressive master bedroom features built-in wardrobes and a spacious, beautifully appointed ensuite. There are also three further generous bedrooms and a modern family bathroom, providing excellent accommodation for families, guests or those requiring flexible home-working space.
Outside, the landscaped south-east-facing garden and paved patio areas provide an attractive private setting for relaxing and entertaining. To the front ample off street parking.
Combining an enviable location with generous proportions, contemporary design and an exceptional standard of presentation, this superb family home is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers.
Early viewing is highly recommended, as properties of this calibre and in such a popular location are sure to generate considerable interest.
